name: vega: the simplest chart references the dataset
description: The tool's floor. One scatter, no derived data, so the only correct outcome is a spec pointing at /api/datasets/<id>/display with no rows in it. Asserts the reference rather than the tool, so a Galaxy plugin answering instead would also have to reference.
inputs: Plot Glucose against BMI from the dataset in this history as a scatter plot. Put the chart in the record page.
